verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs assert it is an 'open source platform' (pulumi-docs-28) and GitHub hosts the core engine, but the evidence pack contains no details on the specific license (e.g., Apache 2.0 terms), no mention of a foundation or multi-vendor governance structure, and no explicit commitment against relicensing — governance appears to be single-vendor (Pulumi Corp) controlled. missing for 10: explicit license text/terms, open governance model (e.g., neutral foundation, multiple maintaining companies), any public commitment or history preventing relicensing.
